PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://lbrontek.github.io/refinements/1.1/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?zone ?sensor ?ts_id
WHERE {
  ?zone a brick:Zone .
  ?sensor brick:hasSubComponent ?zone ;
          a brick:ElectricPowerSensor .
  ref:ts ?sensor ?ts_id .
}
LIMIT 200
SELECT ?cls (COUNT(*) AS ?n) WHERE { ?s a ?cls } GROUP BY ?cls ORDER BY ?n DESC LIMIT 200
